name: Cortex
subtitle: Local-first LLM chat for iPhone
localizedDescription: Cortex is a local-first iPhone app for on-device AI conversations. It supports voice dictation, image-aware prompts, and local model workflows without making the app read like a remote chat shell first.
versionDescription: First public Cortex release through the official SideLink source.

privacy: Camera: Capture a photo and analyze it entirely on-device with local vision models.
Photo Library: Attach images to local conversations.
Microphone: Dictate prompts directly into local conversations.
Speech Recognition: Transcribe dictated prompts before running them on-device.
